claim: ReaperAnon's Middle-Earth-Mod-Loader is a bink2w64.dll proxy (original renamed bink2w64_.dll) that loads plugin DLLs from a plugins folder, uses MinHook and a byte-pattern scan of ShadowOfWar.exe, and exposes a small menu/log plugin API.
evidence: README install renames bink2w64.dll; gamehook.cpp scans a 6-byte pattern then MH_CreateHook.
game_build_compatibility: UNKNOWN - README states no build. Third-party notes (coop-anything) claim its pattern matches build 3095001 once; not verified by us.
verification_method: Read source via raw.githubusercontent.com at the pinned commit (not built/run). Verify by counting pattern matches in a copied exe's code section (static, no execution).
limitations: No license declared; repo ships a prebuilt output/bink2w64.dll (untrusted, do not run). Community reports crashes when changing options/photo mode with the loader. Proxying Bink means the proxy loads early, before Denuvo/SteamStub behaviour is known.
next_experiment: Static check: confirm bink2w64.dll is imported by ShadowOfWar.exe (PE import table of a copy) and that the loader's pattern matches exactly once in our build.
